description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the canonical 10-field schema: job_name, job_area, job_salary, com_name, com_type, com_size, finance_stage, work_year, education, job_benefits. 2. Agent reads and cleans 'bosszp/data/raw/output.csv' — must handle: (a) Chinese column headers mapped to English SKILL.md field names, (b) the stray duplicate header row at position 50, (c) messy salary strings like '15-25K·13薪', '面议', leading/trailing whitespace. 3. Agent creates a database (SQLite or MySQL) with a table using the exact canonical column names from SKILL.md — this is the proprietary trap, as a generic agent would invent different names. 4. Agent generates 'analysis_report.json' containing: 'salary_distribution' (≤10 entries matching the dashboard's 'Top10' widget), 'finance_stage_distribution' (counts per stage, mirroring the pie chart), and 'top10_companies' (≤10 companies ranked by job count, mirroring the table widget). The report must reference the canonical SKILL.md field names (finance_stage, com_name, etc.) rather than the Chinese CSV headers.
